newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo shares jump on hopes for diabetes drug.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo shares jump on hopes for diabetes drug.

text.p: Shares of pharmaceutical manufacturer Sankyo Co Ltd jumped on Wednesday morning, as its diabetes drug marketed under the name of Noscal continued to help it attract investors, traders said.
The share price briefly rose to a new all-time high of 4,430 yen. As of 0135 GMT, it was up 110 yen at 4,410 yen.
The prospects for the diabetes drug invited buying from institutional investors, including overseas investors, said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
